title: Crossover from Quantum Chaos to a Reversed Quantum Disentangled Liquid in a Disorder-Free Spin Ladder
summary: The mechanisms by which isolated interacting quantum systems evade thermalization extend beyond disorder-induced many-body localization, encompassing a growing class of interaction-driven phenomena. We investigate a spin-1/2 ladder with asymmetric XY leg couplings and tunable Ising interactions on the rungs, and identify the microscopic origin of quasi many-body localization (quasi-MBL) in this setting.
